visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two individuals, a man in a blue winter jacket and a woman in a bright yellow jacket with a prominent red hood and oversized black goggles, are on a bright, snowy mountain slope. The man is laughing with squinted eyes while the woman lies in the deep snow, gesturing with her hands. (2) A close-up shot shows a wooden stick holding a small mound of snow shaped specifically like a cartoonish poop emoji. The background is a flat, bright white snow surface. (3) A wide shot features a modern, triangular architectural building (station entrance) surrounded by massive snowdrifts under a clear blue sky. (4) The scene shifts to a dark, concrete underground tunnel with a long, steep flight of stairs leading downwards. The woman in the red hood looks around the cavernous space. (5) A close-up of feet walking across a wooden walkway next to a stone-paved indoor footbath channel. (6) The woman opens a sliding glass door from a warm-lit indoor room, only to be met by a solid wall of packed snow blocking the exit.
